xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The Standalone Financial Results are prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards ('Ind AS') notified under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, read with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015, as amended.

2. The Board of Directors have declared an interim dividend of Rs 5.75 (Rupees Five and Paise Seventy Five only) per equity share of the face value of, 1 each for the financial year ending 31st March 2027. The record date for the purpose of payment of interim dividend is fixed as 4th November 2026.

3. The Company has commenced commercial production of Vinyl Acetate Ethylene Emulsion (VAE) on 17th September 2026 at its VAE manufacturing facility in Dahej, Gujarat. The facility has an installed capacity of 1,50,000 tons per annum.

4. The Company is primarily engaged in the business of 'Paints and Decor'. There is no separate reportable segment as per Ind AS 108 - Operating Segments.

5. The Standalone Financial Results were reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee on 28th October 2026 and subsequently approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on 29th October 2026.

6. The Standalone Statement of Cash Flows has been prepared under the "Indirect Method" as set out in the Indian Accounting Standard (Ind AS 7) Statement of Cash Flows.

Please note that the Basic and diluted Earnings per share are reported for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 and are not annualised.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RelatedPartyTransactionExplana: 1. Relationship of the counterparty with the listed entity (Asian Paints Limited) is reported. 2. Value of the transaction approved by the Audit Committee pertains to the entire financial year 2026-27. 3. The term 'subsidiary' includes step down subsidiaries of the Company. 4. Audit Committee's approval is not applicable for the Company's transactions with its wholly owned subsidiaries, transactions within two wholly owned subsidiaries, and transactions of subsidiaries with its related parties where value of transaction is less than 10% of the subsidiary's previous year's turnover. 5. Remuneration reported pertains to the amount paid during the period including variable pay of previous year but does not include provisions towards variable pay, compensated absences and retiral benefits etc. 6. Reimbursements to employees and directors as per company policy has not been covered above. 7. The Company has issued letters of awareness to banks/ financial institutions with respect to loans taken by certain international subsidiary companies. In this regard, there has been no guarantee given or provided to any related party. Hence, the same has not been included here in the balances as well as transactions. 8. Transactions between members of the Group (between Asian Paints Limited and its subsidiary or between subsidiaries) are reported once. 9. Difference in opening and closing balances is on account of transactions during the period / exchange rate fluctuation in case of foreign currency. 10. Amounts reported are inclusive of GST wherever applicable. 11. In accordance with SEBI circular issued during 2024-25, corporate actions such as dividend, rights issue of share are not considered as related party transaction, hence the same is not disclosed. Transactions of remuneration with non promoter group are not required to be reported and are hence excluded.
